title: Fire Pro Gaiden Blazing Tornado
native_title: ファイ・プロ外伝 ブレイジング・トルネード
overview:
Decide the strongest man in the world with pro wrestling!!

Blazing Tornado brings the arcade wrestling brawler home to the Sega Saturn. Pick one of eight colorful fighters, from masked luchadors to a brawling cowboy and an aging martial arts master, and climb into the ring of the Heroic Wrestling Federation. Pound away at the buttons to win grapples, slam your opponent to the mat and fight through a tournament to claim the vacant championship belt.

- Singles and tag team tournaments
- One or two players
- Virtua Stick compatible

世界最強の男はプロレスで決めろ!!
